glosses: so, dass es diskutiert werden kann

examples.text: „Uli war sich völlig klar darüber, daß wir uns seinetwegen Sorgen machten, und er glaubte, wir wollten diese Sorgen durch Verbannung loswerden. Auch ein Punkt, der nicht diskutierbar war.“
„Nein, bitte: ich lehne jede Debatte ab; Madeirasauce ist für mich nicht diskutierbar.“
„Es wäre ein grober Vertrauensbruch dem Staate gegenüber. Wie tief bin ich abermals gesunken, daß ich diese Frage diskutierbar finden konnte!“

glosses: Open to debate; not fully proved or confirmed.

examples.text: Those data are debatable: no one has been able to replicate them.
It's debatable whether he is the best candidate for the position.

While the SCP universe is, of course, filled with things that we would certainly not consider "real", most of the SCPs are tangible or perceivable in some way. There are those concepts, however, whose reality is debatable, even to the SCP Foundation, begging them to ask the question of what, exactly, is real.
There’s been a change in President Donald Trump. He used to say he had accomplished more than any other President, a debatable claim. But now he’s using messianic language about himself.

glosses: Able to be debated; up for discussion.

examples.text: The lack of bonuses this year is not debatable.

glosses: A topic that is open to debate.

examples.text: Just how many glaucoma patients there are in the United States and just how prevalent is the disease are two unknowns or at least two debatables.
